classes.name: Assassin
classes.description:
A remorseless killer trained in the use of poisons and specializes in stealth.

Assassins have a major skill bonus to Alchemy and minor skill bonuses to Archery, Light Armor, Security, Sneak, and One-Handed.
Assassins begin the game with Light Armor, a Dagger, a Long Bow, and some weak poisons.

Assassins gain the Brotherhood Tactics ability, increasing poison uses and bolstering the effectiveness of poisons delivered by sneak attacks.
classes.startingGear: Light Armor, a Dagger, a Long Bow, and some weak poisons

effects.name: Brotherhood Tactics
effects.description: Your poisons last for 2 additional hits, and poisons delivered by sneak attacks are twice as strong.

classes.name: Barbarian
classes.description:
A violent and short-tempered individual, frequently choosing to settle disputes through the glory of combat.

Barbarians have a major skill bonus to Light Armor and minor skill bonuses to Archery, Block, Hand to Hand, Smithing, and Two-Handed.
Barbarians begin the game with Light Armor, a Warhammer, and a Long Bow.

Barbarians gain the Berserker's Frenzy ability, allowing them to spend less Stamina while power attacking or drawing a bow.
classes.startingGear: Light Armor, a Warhammer, and a Long Bow

effects.name: Berserker's Frenzy
effects.description: You spend 20% less Stamina when power attacking, drawing a bow, jumping, or sprinting.

classes.name: Bard
classes.description:
A master of song and speech, a charismatic individual who always gets their way.

Bards have a major skill bonus to Speech and minor skill bonuses to Alchemy, Illusion, Light Armor, Security, and One-Handed.
Bards begin the game with Light Armor, a Sword, Calm, and Healing.

Bards gain the Bardic Inspiration ability, fortifying the attributes of nearby allies.
classes.startingGear: Light Armor, a Sword, Calm, and Healing

effects.name: Bardic Inspiration
effects.description: Nearby allies have their Health, Magicka, and Stamina increased by 50.

classes.name: Battlemage
classes.description:
A versatile fighter, proficient with both spell and blade.

Battlemages have a major skill bonus to Alteration and minor skill bonuses to Conjuration, Destruction, Enchanting, Heavy Armor, and One-Handed.
Battlemages begin the game with Heavy Armor, a War Axe, Flames, Healing, Oakflesh, and Soul Trap.

Battlemages gain the Magicka Battery ability, allowing them restore Magicka with their melee attacks while under the effects of an armor spell.
classes.startingGear: Heavy Armor, a War Axe, Flames, Healing, Oakflesh, and Soul Trap

effects.name: Magicka Battery
effects.description: Your melee attacks and bashes restore Magicka while under the effects of an armor spell.

classes.name: Crusader
classes.description:
A holy, or unholy, knight skilled in both martial and magical disciplines.

Crusaders have a major skill bonus to Restoration and minor skill bonuses to Block, Destruction, Heavy Armor, Smithing, and One-Handed.
Crusaders begin the game with Heavy Armor, a Mace, Flames, and Healing.

Crusaders gain the Aura of Protection ability, reducing damage taken for both themselves and their allies.
warnings: Description says major skill Restoration, script gives none.
Description lists minor skill Destruction, script does not raise it.
Script raises Restoration as a minor skill, description does not list it.
classes.startingGear: Heavy Armor, a Mace, Flames, and Healing

effects.name: Aura of Protection
effects.description: You and nearby allies resist 10% of incoming weapon and spell damage.

classes.name: Hero
classes.description:
A kind, virtuous adventurer who has traveled far and wide in search of new foes and evils.

Heroes have a major skill bonus to Heavy Armor and minor skill bonuses to Alchemy, Block, Smithing, Speech, and Two-Handed.
Heroes begin the game with Heavy Armor, a Greatsword, a Sword, and a Shield.

Heroes gain the Himmel's Resolve ability, reducing the incoming poise damage and allowing them to inflict more poise damage.
classes.startingGear: Heavy Armor, a Greatsword, a Sword, and a Shield

effects.name: Himmel's Resolve
effects.description: You resist 20% of incoming poise damage and deal 25% more poise damage.

classes.name: Mage
classes.description:
A master of the arcane, capable of solving any problem with a little bit of magic.

Mages have a major skill bonus to Destruction and minor skill bonuses to Alteration, Conjuration, Enchanting, Illusion, and Restoration.
Mages begin the game with Robes and basic spells for all schools.

Mages gain the Arcane Affinity ability, increasing their Magicka Regeneration and reducing the cost of their spells.
warnings: Description lists minor skill Enchanting, script does not raise it.
classes.startingGear: Robes and basic spells for all schools

effects.name: Arcane Affinity
effects.description: Your spells and enchantments cost 10% less, and your Magicka Regeneration is increased by 50%.

classes.name: Monk
classes.description:
An unarmed fighter and specialist who is able to manipulate their energy to enhance their strikes.

Monks have a major skill bonus to Hand to Hand and minor skill bonuses to Alteration, Archery, Restoration, Security, and Speech.
Monks begin the game with Robes, a Long Bow, Oakflesh, and Healing.

Monks gain the Attenuation ability, allowing them to deal additional damage with their unarmed strikes based on their resistances.
warnings: Description lists minor skill Speechcraft, script does not raise it.
Script raises Sneak as a minor skill, description does not list it.
classes.startingGear: Robes, a Long Bow, Oakflesh, and Healing

effects.name: Attenuation
effects.description: Your unarmed attacks have a chance to deal additional elemental damage based on your resistances.

classes.name: Nightblade
classes.description:
An cunning opportunist who has learned to wield both spell and blade.

Nightblades have a major skill bonus to Illusion and minor skill bonuses to Alchemy, Destruction, Light Armor, One-Handed, and Sneak.
Nightblades begin the game with Light Armor, a Dagger, Calm, and Flames.

Nightblades gain the Veil Touched ability, increasing their movement speed while sneaking and increasing the damage they deal with sneak attacks.
warnings: Description lists minor skill Alchemy, script does not raise it.
classes.startingGear: Light Armor, a Dagger, Calm, and Flames

effects.name: Veil Touched
effects.description: You move 20% faster while sneaking and deal 25% extra damage with sneak attacks.

classes.name: Prisoner
classes.description:
An individual with no past to speak of, a complete enigma.
Prisoners begin the game with no starting skill bonuses or equipment, other than a Rusted Mace, Flames, and Healing.

Prisoners gain the Manifest Destiny ability, granting 1 additional perk point.
classes.startingGear: no starting skill bonuses or equipment, other than a Rusted Mace, Flames, and Healing

effects.name: Manifest Destiny
effects.description: You start with 1 additional Perk point.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description:
A resourceful and cunning combatant, experienced in both duels and diplomacy.

Rogues have a major skill bonus to One-Handed and minor skill bonuses to Block, Light Armor, Security, Sneak, and Speech.
Rogues begin the game with Light Armor and a Sword.

Rogues gain the Opportunist ability, giving them a chance to become intangible during incoming melee attacks and gain the upper hand in combat.

effects.name: Opportunist
effects.description: You have a chance to become intangible for 3 seconds during incoming melee attacks. You deal 50% more damage while intangible.

classes.name: Soldier
classes.description:
A versatile, weapons-oriented fighter skilled in all martial disciplines.

Soldiers have a major skill bonus to Block and minor skill bonuses to Archery, Heavy Armor, One-Handed, Smithing, and Two-Handed.
Soldiers begin the game with Heavy Armor, a War Axe, a Long Bow, and a Shield.

Soldiers gain the Martial Training ability, increasing their Health and Stamina Regeneration.
warnings: Description says major skill Block, script gives none.
Description lists minor skill TwoHanded, script does not raise it.
Script raises Block as a minor skill, description does not list it.
classes.startingGear: Heavy Armor, a War Axe, a Long Bow, and a Shield

effects.name: Martial Training
effects.description: Your Health and Stamina Regeneration is increased by 50%.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.description:
An expert in magical objects and items, but typically not a primary spell-caster.

Sorcerers have a major skill bonus to Enchanting and minor skill bonuses to Alteration, Conjuration, Destruction, Heavy Armor, and Restoration.
Sorcerers begin the game with Heavy Armor, a Staff of Flames, Healing, and Soul Trap.

Sorcerers gain the Artificer ability, allowing them to use enchanted items for longer and find more scrolls in their travels.
classes.startingGear: Heavy Armor, a Staff of Flames, Healing, and Soul Trap

effects.name: Artificer
effects.description: Your enchantments cost 25% less, and you find uncommon scrolls much more often.

classes.name: Summoner
classes.description:
A individual capable of summoning powerful entities or reanimating the undead to do their bidding.

Summoners have a major skill bonus to Conjuration and minor skill bonuses to Alchemy, Alteration, Destruction, Restoration, and Sneak.
Summoners begin the game with Robes, Flames, Healing, Conjure Spectral Wolf, and Raise Zombie.

Summoners gain the Binding Vow ability, allowing them to control an additional summon or zombie
classes.startingGear: Robes, Flames, Healing, Conjure Spectral Wolf, and Raise Zombie

effects.name: Binding Vow
effects.description: You can summon or reanimate 1 additional minion.

classes.name: Vagabond
classes.description:
One who was banished, exiled, or maybe just wandered a little too far from home.

Vagabonds have a major skill bonus to Two-Handed and minor skill bonuses to Archery, Block, Heavy Armor, Security, and Smithing.
Vagabonds begin the game with Heavy Armor, a Battleaxe, and a Long Bow.

Vagabonds gain the Seasoned Veteran ability, reducing the damage taken while power attacking, drawing a bow, or blocking.
classes.startingGear: Heavy Armor, a Battleaxe, and a Long Bow

effects.name: Seasoned Veteran
effects.description: You resist 25% of incoming weapon and spell damage when power attacking, drawing a bow, or blocking.

classes.name: Witch Hunter
classes.description:
A individual dedicated to hunting those who wield dangerous magic.

Witch Hunters have a major skill bonus to Archery and minor skill bonuses to Alchemy, Conjuration, Enchanting, Heavy Armor, and Two-Handed.
Witch Hunters begin the game with Robes, a Greatsword, a Long Bow, and Conjure Familiar.

Witch Hunters gain the Perfect Preparation ability, increasing the duration of their potions and allowing them to absorb incoming spells.
warnings: Description lists minor skill HeavyArmor, script does not raise it.
Script raises Sneak as a minor skill, description does not list it.
classes.startingGear: Robes, a Greatsword, a Long Bow, and Conjure Familiar

effects.name: Perfect Preparation
effects.description: Your potions last 50% longer, and you have a 10% chance to absorb the Magicka from incoming spells.
